Formulation
- Brief summary: The patient presents with an acute unilateral migraine with left-sided pain, blurred vision, zigzag lines, nausea/vomiting, dizziness, and photophobia. Pain began suddenly this morning; paracetamol provided no relief. She reports significant worry about serious pathology (brain tumor or stroke) and describes herself as somewhat health-anxious. Family history includes migraines and hypothyroidism. No neurological deficits reported; no weakness or ataxia. Not on regular medications; no known drug allergies. Plan includes pharmacologic migraine relief and further assessment if symptoms persist or worsen.
